commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-hwq-final-docs.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --branch main https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
cd "$WORK/source"
EXPECTED="c4bf62cf70b5197f5b19906cf48175a75719785e"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
echo "FINAL_SHA|$EXPECTED"
git diff --check 1a1b3de8dada926a00f37be158ef99cd1393b860 HEAD
echo "DIFF_CHECK|PASS"
test -f docs/checkpoints/2026-11-07-bloomml-ipo-v2-hardware-qualification-gate.md
grep -Fq "ClosedIpoActivationGate" docs/NEXT_CHAT.md
grep -Fq "ClosedIpoActivationGate" src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp
grep -Fq "ipo_nvs_journal_tests" test/host/CMakeLists.txt
grep -Fq "GROWBOX_STAGE28_REAL_OUTPUTS_ENABLED" config/runtime/GrowboxRuntimeConfig.cmake
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "CHECKPOINT_AND_CLOSED_GATE|PASS"
echo "SOURCE_CLEAN|PASS"
